properties.description: Two test files, run by `cargo test --workspace` in CI. crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/loop_status_says_what_is_not_exported.rs (10 tests, through the real binary where a door is named): a never-exported design raises the item FIRST in `next`, with `export_standing` state never_exported, severity high and the gap id, naming export_graph through MCP stdio and `--call export_graph` through --call and read; graph_report carries it; one export_graph ends it on --call and read; acknowledge_gap on gap:the-design-has-never-been-exported stops the line and reviewed_gaps says where the gap is raised; a design served without its tree is not told; two sessions that declared writes_for come back as two groups with their own counts and ids, and the headline names both; an exported, current store gets no export_standing, no unexported, no ahead_of_export and no export line in `next`; the item stays under 1,500 chars on a 300-node store and the list under 12,000 chars for 300 changes by 25 writers; `ahead_of_export` is within the first 40 printed lines (it is the first key) behind a 40-artifact unmeasurable block through --call and read, exact with since_export, and sync_status carries it while each record's state stays in_step. crates/reflow2-core/tests/unexported_changes_say_whose_they_are.rs (5 tests): the grouping, uncredited work and removals under written_by: None, an epoch group with its date window, nothing on an up-to-date store, and the bound at 600 changes across 30 writers. WHAT IT DOES NOT COVER: whether a person reads the line and exports; a real multi-session history (every case builds its sessions in-test); and the hosted case's own wording, which is open in dec:idea-loop-status-says-whether-an-export-is-owed-on-a-hosted-design.
properties.findings: OBSERVED FAILING FIRST (commit e4e3aaf4e, the tests alone, on main 1609fb01b): 9 of the 10 MCP tests failed. The never-exported tests failed on `next` holding only "1 open gap(s) have never been put to the user" on MCP stdio, --call and read; the acknowledgement, two-session, up-to-date-with-since_export and bounded tests found no `export_standing` / `unexported` (Null); the export and headline tests failed in their fixture (`export_graph` refuses a path whose folder is missing) and were fixed by creating the folder. The tree-less guard passed there and is a counterweight. The core test did not compile (no reflow2_core::unexported). PASSING AFTER (commit 4aedbe33e, re-run after merging main 28ed14c83 at 995b9cea8): 10/10 MCP tests, with the_record_moved_and_the_session_is_told (26) and the_server_keeps_the_export_current (4) unchanged and passing; 5/5 core tests; the full core suite passed apart from derived_relations_are_declared_and_checked, which named the five new edge readers until they were listed in schema/derived/edge_readers.yaml. Read on the built binary: a never-exported --call loop_status prints `ahead_of_export` as its first key and the never-exported line first in `next`.
properties.name: loop_status says a design was never exported, leads with whether the store is ahead of its export, and lists unexported changes by who wrote them, on every door
